{{Quote|Samples of the flora and fauna were collected and taken to the Emperor's private and public gardens and may be available for study at the Imperial Zoological Gardens on Kailor V.|Imperial Survey Corps report|<ref name="Abduction" />}}
The '''Imperial Zoological Gardens''' were a facility located on [[Kailor V]],<ref name="Abduction" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Kailor">{{CSWECite|II|193|Kailor V}}</ref> in the [[Arrowhead]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kailor system/Legends|Kailor system]]</ref> Established on the authority of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="CSWE Gardens">{{CSWECite|II|97|Imperial Zoological Gardens}}</ref> of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Abduction" /> they featured a beautiful display of fauna and [[Plant/Legends|flora]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CSWE Gardens" /> The facility included various [[Aquarium/Legends|aquaria]],<ref name="CSWE Kailor" /> with members of the [[Sedrian]] [[Shahlik family]] being charged with their maintenance.<ref name="GG4">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref> When the Empire surveyed the<ref name="Abduction" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Najarka system/Legends|Najarka system]]</ref> planet [[Najarka]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it collected samples of the world's plants and creatures, which were subsequently made available for study at the Imperial Zoological Gardens&mdash;a fact that was noted in a publicly accessible [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] planetary report.<ref name="Abduction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Zoological Gardens were introduced in ''[[The Abduction]]'', a [[1992]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Chuck Truett]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Abduction" /> The [[1994]] [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|Second Edition]] of West End Games' roleplaying sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'' mentioned "Imperial aquaria" on Kailor V,<ref name="GG4" /> which [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' subsequently confirmed as part of the Imperial Zoological Gardens.<ref name="CSWE Kailor" />
